app.name: Zendesk Change Watch
app.short_description: Monitor Zendesk configuration changes, manage personal alerts, and request clarifications.
app.long_description: Zendesk Change Watch provides visibility into instance configuration changes from Zendesk Audit Logs, personal deduplicated alert rules, and audit-linked clarification threads backed by Zendesk Custom Objects.
app.installation_instructions: Install as a private Support nav bar app and configure role access in Admin Center.
